name: Thriving Moor
oracle_text:
This land enters tapped. As it enters, choose a color other than black.
{T}: Add {B} or one mana of the chosen color.
blocked_sentences: As it enters, choose a color other than black.
{T}: Add {B} or one mana of the chosen color.

needs.what: a `choose_color` that excludes printed colours from the offer -- e.g. `{"op": "choose_color", "except_colors": ["B"]}` for "choose a color other than black" -- so the chooser is offered only the four remaining colours and `chosen_color` can never be the excluded one
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `choose_color` (op_options: only `prompt`) always offers all five colours, so the land could choose black and then tap for only {B}, which is a different card from the printed one

needs.what: a mana ability offering a fixed symbol OR the permanent's chosen colour -- "{T}: Add {B} or one mana of the chosen color" -- i.e. a `choose_mode` whose modes are `add_mana {B}` and `add_mana {"chosen_color_of": "self"}`, with the solver's options being {B} plus the source's live `chosen_color`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The loader's chosen-colour mana branch requires the ability be a single `add_mana` with `{"chosen_color_of": "self"}` and refuses a second effect; a `choose_mode` over five literal colours (the starting_point) taps for any colour, strictly better than the printed card
